dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (IV)
dialogues.text: "Return home and accept my guidance. Accept my love, oh, Shiruyeh, son of Kisra..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (IV)
dialogues.text: "Here shall you don a mask of brass. Here shall you claim your true name, and you shall see your mother's true affections..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (IV)
dialogues.text: "Then, seek your father out, for the pomegranate's nectar has flowed out with the spilling of liquor... Seek your father out and bring an end to this farce..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (IV)
dialogues.text: "Go to Gurabad and seek your father. I will await you there..."
